Dishwasher installation Perth: service scope

  • Supply the agreed dishwasher, disconnect and remove the old unit, and take it away.
  • Check the proposed water supply, drainage and available electrical connection.
  • Include required plumbing and fixed electrical work in the written scope through the appropriate trade.
  • Cabinet alterations, new service routes and internal appliance repairs are separate from a standard connection and are not automatically included.

We confirm the property, installation and requested outcome before selecting the work. Fixed plumbing and electrical tasks are handled by the appropriate qualified trade; a coordinated visit does not make every task interchangeable. Current documentation relevant to the proposed work can be requested privately.

Dishwasher Installation & Connections Perth FAQs

Prepare the request and approval

Give the property location, observable symptoms or intended installation, access contact and the person who can approve the work. The agreed quote sets out the assessment and work; submitting a form does not reserve an appointment.

  • Perth plumbing services
  • Kitchen and laundry connection overview
  • Sink drainage and backflow
  • Electrical outlet requirements
  • Leaking supply taps and mixers
Can you supply the dishwasher and take away the old one?

Yes. Supply, removal and taking away the old unit are available within the agreed installation package. Confirm the selected appliance, access and the included connection work in the written quote.

Is a leaking dishwasher hose a plumbing issue or an appliance repair issue?

A leak at the supply valve, connection or external hose may involve plumbing; a leak inside the machine may require appliance repair. The source needs assessment. A wet cupboard alone does not establish which trade or component is responsible.

Can you check the water and drain connections before installation?

Yes. We assess the existing connections and proposed product before agreeing the installation. Report leaking valves, slow drainage or previous overflows so those issues are included in the assessment.

Does dishwasher installation include cabinet changes or a new power point?

Not automatically. New pipework, a new power point, circuit changes and cabinet alterations must be identified and included or excluded in the quote. The supplied dishwasher alone does not define that additional work.
